PACKMASTER-PACKMASTER_STRIKE.title: Strike
PACKMASTER-PACKMASTER_DEFEND.title: Defend
PACKMASTER-RUMMAGE.title: Rummage
PACKMASTER-RUMMAGE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards} and reduce {Cards:plural:its|their} cost by {CostReduction} this turn.
PACKMASTER-CARDISTRY.title: Cardistry
PACKMASTER-CARDISTRY.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Put the next card you play this turn on top of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
PACKMASTER-BACKPACK_SMACK.title: Backpack Smack
PACKMASTER-BACKPACK_SMACK.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage X times.
[gold]Synergy:[/gold] Apply X [gold]Weak[/gold] and [gold]Vulnerable[/gold].
PACKMASTER-BOOSTER_TUTOR.title: Booster Tutor
PACKMASTER-BOOSTER_TUTOR.description: Put {Cards:diff()} random cards from different Packs from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
PACKMASTER-DESTINY_DRAW.title: Destiny Draw
PACKMASTER-DESTINY_DRAW.description: Choose 1 of 3 random cards from different Packs to add to your [gold]Hand[/gold]. It costs 0 this turn.
PACKMASTER-FLICK.title: Flick
PACKMASTER-FLICK.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Discard a card. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage a number of times equal to its cost.
PACKMASTER-MAYHEM_FORM.title: Unrelenting Form
PACKMASTER-MAYHEM_FORM.description: Once per turn, when you reach 2 or fewer cards in [gold]Hand[/gold], draw {Cards} cards and gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
PACKMASTER-RIPPED_PECS.title: Ripped Pecs
PACKMASTER-SHOWOFF.title: Showoff
PACKMASTER-SHOWOFF.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Next turn, draw {Cards} additional cards.
PACKMASTER-SIDEBOARD.title: Sideboard
PACKMASTER-SIDEBOARD.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Put a card from your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] on top of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
PACKMASTER-SIDEBOARD.selectionScreenProm: Choose a card to put on top of your Draw Pile.
PACKMASTER-SMITHING_HAMMER.title: Smithing Hammer
PACKMASTER-SMITHING_HAMMER.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {Hits:diff()} times.
Upgrade {Cards} random cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
PACKMASTER-SYNERGIZE.title: Synergize
PACKMASTER-SYNERGIZE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
[gold]Synergy:[/gold] Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
PACKMASTER-WEIGHT.title: Weight
PACKMASTER-WEIGHT.description: If this card is discarded from your [gold]Hand[/gold], [gold]Exhaust[/gold] it.
PACKMASTER-OPPRESSOR.title: Oppressor
PACKMASTER-IRON_SHIELD.title: Iron Shield
PACKMASTER-SHINE.title: Shine
PACKMASTER-SHINE.description: When you draw this card, [gold]Upgrade[/gold] {IfUpgraded:show:ALL other cards|another random card} in your [gold]Hand[/gold] for the rest of combat.
PACKMASTER-GLAIVE_THROW.title: Glaive Throw
PACKMASTER-GLAIVE_THROW.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
Discard {Cards:diff()} cards.
PACKMASTER-CRUNCH.title: Crunch
PACKMASTER-CRUNCH.description: When you draw this card, draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
PACKMASTER-LIE.title: Lie
PACKMASTER-LIE.description:
Enemy loses {StrengthLoss:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold] this turn.
Add a [gold]Weight[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
PACKMASTER-FRONTFLIP.title: Frontflip
PACKMASTER-FRONTFLIP.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Draw {Cards:diff()} cards, then discard any [gold]Unplayable[/gold] cards drawn.
PACKMASTER-HAMMER_THROW.title: Hammer Throw
PACKMASTER-HAMMER_THROW.description: Whenever a card is [gold]Retained[/gold], deal {HammerThrowPower:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
PACKMASTER-FLAIL.title: Flail
PACKMASTER-FLAIL.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage twice.
Add 2 [gold]Weights[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
PACKMASTER-WISDOM.title: Wisdom
PACKMASTER-WISDOM.description:
Gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
Discard any number of cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold]. Draw that many cards.
PACKMASTER-FRIGID_BODY.title: Frigid Body
PACKMASTER-FRIGID_BODY.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Whenever you are attacked this turn, apply [gold]Frostbite[/gold] equal to blocked damage.
PACKMASTER-FROSTBURN.title: Frostburn
PACKMASTER-FROSTBURN.description:
Apply {FrostbitePower:diff()} [gold]Frostbite[/gold] to ALL enemies.
Add a [gold]Burn[/gold] into your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
PACKMASTER-FROSTED_EDGE.title: Frosted Edge
PACKMASTER-GROWING_AFFLICTION.title: Growing Affliction
PACKMASTER-GROWING_AFFLICTION.descriptio:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Whenever you apply a debuff, return this from your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold] and set its cost to 1.
PACKMASTER-ICE_SHATTER.title: Ice Shatter
PACKMASTER-ICE_SHATTER.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Whenever the enemy loses HP during their next turn, deal {IceShatterPower:diff()} damage.
PACKMASTER-INSULT_TO_INJURY.title: Insult to Injury
PACKMASTER-INSULT_TO_INJURY.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Repeat for each unique debuff the enemy has.
PACKMASTER-REFRIGERATE.title: Refrigerate
PACKMASTER-REFRIGERATE.description:
Apply {FrostbitePower:diff()} [gold]Frostbite[/gold].{IfUpgraded:show:
If the enemy already had [gold]Frostbite[/gold], they lose HP equal to it.|}
PACKMASTER-RELENTLESS_HAIL.title: Relentless Hail
PACKMASTER-RELENTLESS_HAIL.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies {Repeat:diff()} times.
Increase this card's hits by 1 this combat.
PACKMASTER-SNOWED_IN.title: Snowed In
PACKMASTER-SNOWED_IN.description:
Apply {FrostbitePower:diff()} [gold]Frostbite[/gold].
The enemy's [gold]Frostbite[/gold] is not halved this turn.
PACKMASTER-SUBDUE.title: Subdue
PACKMASTER-SUBDUE.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
If the last card played this combat was an Attack, gain {Block:diff()} additional [gold]Block[/gold].
PACKMASTER-IMP.title: Imp
PACKMASTER-IMP.description: When drawn, deal {ImpDamage:diff()} damage to a random enemy, increase the damage of [gold]Imps[/gold] by {Increase:diff()} this combat, [gold]Exhaust[/gold] this, and draw 1 card.
PACKMASTER-HIGH_PRIESTESS_JEKLIK.title: High Priestess Jeklik
PACKMASTER-HIGH_PRIESTESS_JEKLIK.descrip:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
If this card is [gold]Exhausted[/gold], add 2 copies of it to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
PACKMASTER-SOUL_SHEAR.title: Soul Shear
PACKMASTER-SOUL_SHEAR.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Shuffle 1 [gold]Imp[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
PACKMASTER-SOULFIRE.title: Soulfire
PACKMASTER-DOOMGUARD.title: Doomguard
PACKMASTER-DOOMGUARD.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Exhaust[/gold] 2 random cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
PACKMASTER-HAND_OF_GUL_DAN.title: Hand of Gul'dan
PACKMASTER-HAND_OF_GUL_DAN.description:
Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
If this card is [gold]Exhausted[/gold], draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
PACKMASTER-SEEDS_OF_DESTRUCTION.title: Seeds of Destruction
PACKMASTER-SEEDS_OF_DESTRUCTION.descript: Choose to shuffle {DrawImps:diff()} [gold]Imps[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] or add {DiscardImps:diff()} [gold]Imps[/gold] to your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
PACKMASTER-SEEDS_DRAW_OPTION.title: Seeds of Destruction
PACKMASTER-SEEDS_DISCARD_OPTION.title: Seeds of Destruction
PACKMASTER-ARANASI_BROODMOTHER.title: Aranasi Broodmother
PACKMASTER-ARANASI_BROODMOTHER.descripti:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Shuffle this card into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
When you draw this card, gain {DrawBlock:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
PACKMASTER-MALCHEZAARS_IMP.title: Malchezaar's Imp
PACKMASTER-MALCHEZAARS_IMP.description: Whenever a non-Imp card is [gold]Exhausted[/gold], {IfUpgraded:show:shuffle 1 [gold]Imp[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold]|add 1 [gold]Imp[/gold] to your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold]}.
PACKMASTER-THE_SOULARIUM.title: The Soularium
PACKMASTER-RUNED_MITHRIL_ROD.title: Runed Mithril Rod
PACKMASTER-RUNED_MITHRIL_ROD.description: After you draw {Cards:diff()} cards while this is in your [gold]Hand[/gold], reduce the cost of cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold] by 1 this turn and discard this. ({Drawn} drawn)
